selected_hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sailing through crystal-clear turquoise lagoons as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky transform into shades of gold and pink. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable experience.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most iconic and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with exotic marine life including reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and hundreds of tropical fish species. A guided snorkeling safari ensures you discover the best spots while learning about the delicate coral ecosystem. Equipment is provided and the waters are warm and exceptionally clear.
experiences.location: Banana Reef, North Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Indulge in a world-class luxury dining experience at an iconic underwater restaurant, surrounded by panoramic views of the Indian Ocean and its stunning marine life. Savor a curated multi-course menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, international gourmet dishes, and fine wines while fish and rays glide gracefully past the glass walls — a truly magical and romantic dinner for two.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Discover the rich heritage and traditions of the Maldivian people with a guided tour of a local island village. Visit a traditional mosque, watch local craftsmen weave lacquerware, and learn about the island's fishing culture. Cap the experience with a hands-on cooking class where you prepare authentic Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) and garudhiya fish soup.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat
experiences.description: Treat yourselves to the ultimate luxury honeymoon indulgence with a private couples' spa session in an overwater treatment pavilion. Enjoy traditional Maldivian Javanese massages, aromatic flower baths, and rejuvenating body scrubs using locally sourced coconut and sea salt. The open-air deck offers breathtaking views of the lagoon below, making this a deeply relaxing and romantic escape.
experiences.location: Velaa Private Island, Noonu Atoll, Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange speedboat or local ferry transfer to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll. Check in, freshen up, and explore the property. Take a relaxing stroll along the beach to get your bearings and enjoy the turquoise lagoon views.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach or the guesthouse terrace. Enjoy a welcome drink at the guesthouse and chat with staff about budget-friendly tips and local ferry schedules for the days ahead.

meals.breakfast: Eaten before or during the flight
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport — local short-eat snacks like hedhikaa (fish rolls, bajiya) from the airport café for under $5
meals.dinner: Dine at the guesthouse restaurant or a nearby local café — try mas riha (tuna curry) with roshi (flatbread) for around $8–$12

day_by_day.notes: Book your speedboat or local ferry transfer in advance to save money. Local ferries are significantly cheaper ($1–$3) than speedboats ($25–$50) but run on fixed schedules. Confirm transfer options with your guesthouse before arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning house reef snorkeling directly from the guesthouse beach. Most boutique stays in North Malé Atoll have accessible house reefs teeming with reef fish, turtles, and colorful corals. Borrow or rent snorkel gear from the guesthouse ($5–$8/day) and spend 1.5–2 hours exploring.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion organized by the guesthouse to a nearby coral garden or sandbank. These group tours typically cost $20–$35 per person and include snorkel gear and a guide. Look for manta rays, nurse sharks, and vibrant reef fish.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachside stroll at sunset. Collect seashells and enjoy the pink-hued sky. Spend the evening stargazing on the beach — the Maldives has minimal light pollution and stunning night skies.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — typically includes toast, eggs, fresh tropical fruit, and tea/coffee (often included or $5–$8)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch from the guesthouse or a local café near the jetty — tuna sandwich or short eats for $4–$6
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — try garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice and fresh lime, around $8–$10 per person

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — regular sunscreen damages coral reefs and is discouraged or banned in many Maldivian guesthouses. Bring a reusable water bottle to reduce plastic waste and costs.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early local public ferry to Malé City (the capital). Ferries from North Malé Atoll islands run regularly and cost $1–$3. Explore the colorful Malé Fish Market, one of the most vibrant in the Indian Ocean — watch fishermen unload fresh tuna at dawn.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sightseeing in Malé: Visit the Grand Friday Mosque (Masjid al-Sultan Muhammad Thakurufaanu Al Auzam) with its stunning golden dome, the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Old Friday Mosque) built in 1656, and the National Museum (entry ~$3). Walk through the busy local streets and browse the local market for Maldivian handicrafts.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the Malé waterfront (Rasfannu) for sunset views over the harbor. Watch local fishermen return with their catch. Take the ferry back to your guesthouse in North Malé Atoll.

meals.breakfast: Local Maldivian breakfast at a tea shop (sai hotaa) in Malé — mas huni (shredded tuna with coconut) and roshi for $3–$5
meals.lunch: Eat at a local restaurant in Malé — hedhikaa short eats platter or a rice and curry meal for $5–$8
meals.dinner: Back at the guesthouse — grilled fresh fish with coconut rice, around $10–$14

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting mosques — cover shoulders and knees. Non-Muslims are not permitted inside during prayer times. Keep a copy of your ferry schedule to avoid missing the last return ferry to your island.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga or meditation session on the beach (many budget guesthouses offer free or low-cost sessions). Followed by a leisurely swim in the crystal-clear lagoon. Practice identifying fish species using a reef fish ID card (available at most dive shops for $5).
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget dolphin-watching cruise — one of the most romantic and magical experiences in the Maldives. Group sunset dolphin cruises typically cost $25–$40 per person and depart in the late afternoon. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in North Malé Atoll.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic candlelit dinner arranged on the beach by your guesthouse (ask in advance — many budget guesthouses offer this for $30–$60 for two, including food). Enjoy fresh grilled seafood under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh papaya, banana pancakes, and local tea
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the guesthouse — tuna salad wrap or noodles for $6–$9
meals.dinner: Beachside candlelit dinner — fresh grilled lobster or reef fish with tropical salad (pre-arranged with guesthouse, $15–$30 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the dolphin cruise and beachside dinner at least one day in advance. For the most romantic experience, request a private table setup on the beach. Bring a light shawl for the evening sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day snorkeling trip to a nearby uninhabited island or protected marine area. Many guesthouses organize day trips to top snorkel spots like Banana Reef or HP Reef in North Malé Atoll for $40–$60 per person including boat, guide, and lunch. These are among the best snorkel/dive sites in the world.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling at the second stop of the day trip — look for hawksbill turtles, eagle rays, and schools of fusiliers. Spend time relaxing on a pristine uninhabited sandbank — bring your camera for stunning photos.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the guesthouse by late afternoon. Rinse gear, shower, and relax. Enjoy a refreshing fresh coconut on the beach ($2–$3 from local vendors) while journaling or reading.

meals.breakfast: Early guesthouse breakfast before departure — boiled eggs, toast, and fruit
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included in the day trip — typically grilled fish, rice, salad, and water
meals.dinner: Local guesthouse dinner — mixed seafood curry with coconut rice and fresh salad, $10–$15

day_by_day.notes: Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, a rash guard, and plenty of water. The Maldivian sun is intense even on cloudy days. A GoPro or waterproof camera is highly recommended for this day.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and leisure morning — sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and lounge by the beach. Take a peaceful kayak paddle around the lagoon (kayak rental ~$10–$15/hour from the guesthouse). Explore the shallow sandbars and mangrove areas nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local inhabited island nearby via public ferry. Experience authentic Maldivian village life — see traditional dhoni boat building, visit a local school (if permitted), and browse small local shops for affordable souvenirs like lacquerware and woven mats.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset photography session on the beach — the North Malé Atoll offers spectacular sunset views. Practice long-exposure photography of the glowing horizon. Enjoy a quiet, romantic evening on the beach with your travel companion.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — French toast with honey and fresh coconut milk
meals.lunch: Local tea shop on the inhabited island — short eats and fresh lime juice for $4–$6
meals.dinner: Cook a simple meal at the guesthouse if a kitchen is available, or dine at a local café — tuna pasta or fried rice for $7–$10

day_by_day.notes: When visiting local inhabited islands, dress conservatively — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim community. Alcohol is not available on local islands; it is only served at resort islands.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — treat yourself to a budget-friendly spa experience at the guesthouse or a nearby spa. Many guesthouses offer affordable massages ($30–$50/hour) using coconut oil. This is a perfect romantic treat for honeymoon couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sandbank picnic excursion — arrange with the guesthouse to be dropped off on a private sandbank for 2–3 hours with a picnic basket ($30–$50 for two including boat transfer and food). Wade in ankle-deep turquoise water and feel like you have your own private island.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing night — lay on the beach with a blanket and enjoy the Milky Way. The Maldives, sitting just above the equator, offers incredible views of both northern and southern constellations. Many guesthouses can arrange a stargazing guide for a small fee.

meals.breakfast: Special mid-trip breakfast — fresh fruit platter, yogurt, granola, and Maldivian black tea
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic — fresh tuna sandwiches, tropical fruit, coconut water, and cookies
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — grilled mahi-mahi with lemon butter sauce, steamed vegetables, and coconut rice, $12–$16

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank excursion is one of the most romantic highlights of any Maldives trip — highly recommended for honeymoon couples. Book it at least one day ahead. Bring a bluetooth speaker for music and a waterproof phone case.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the house reef to catch the most active marine life at dawn. Turtles and reef sharks are often spotted in the early morning. Spend 1–2 hours in the water before the day heats up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget introductory scuba diving experience (Discover Scuba Diving) if you're not certified — most guesthouses partner with local dive centers offering intro dives for $70–$100 per person. Even one dive in the Maldives is a life-changing experience. Certified divers can do a 2-tank dive for $80–$120.
day_by_day.evening: Relax and decompress after diving — it's important not to fly or do strenuous activity after diving. Enjoy a quiet evening at the guesthouse, sip fresh coconut water, and watch the sunset from the beach.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-dive breakfast — toast, banana, and tea (avoid heavy meals before diving)
meals.lunch: Post-dive meal at the dive center or guesthouse café — tuna wrap and fresh juice, $6–$9
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — chicken curry with roshi and a fresh salad, $9–$13

day_by_day.notes: Do not fly within 18–24 hours of your last dive. Stay well hydrated before and after diving. If you're not comfortable with scuba, snorkeling at the house reef offers equally stunning underwater views at zero extra cost.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the guesthouse island on foot or by bicycle (bike rental ~$5–$10/day). Discover hidden beach spots, local fishing jetties, and lush tropical vegetation. Visit a local mosque exterior and admire traditional Maldivian architecture.
day_by_day.afternoon: DIY snorkeling at a nearby reef accessible by a short swim or kayak from the beach. Bring a waterproof map of the reef from the guesthouse. Spend the afternoon at your own pace, exploring coral formations and marine life without a guided tour.
day_by_day.evening: Movie night on the beach — some guesthouses set up outdoor movie screenings. If not available, enjoy a romantic evening walk along the shoreline, collecting bioluminescent plankton glowing in the water (March is a good season for this phenomenon).

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — coconut porridge with fresh mango and local tea
meals.lunch: Self-catered beach picnic — buy local snacks and fruit from the island shop for $5–$8
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — fresh grilled red snapper with coconut sambal and steamed rice, $10–$14

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton (sea fireflies) can sometimes be seen on dark, calm nights near the shoreline — wade in slowly and watch the water light up blue around your feet. This is a magical, completely free experience.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to a nearby resort island for a day-pass experience — some luxury resorts in North Malé Atoll sell day passes ($50–$150 per person) that include access to their beach, pool, water sports, and sometimes lunch. This is the most budget-friendly way to experience Maldivian luxury.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the resort facilities on your day pass — use the infinity pool, lounge on pristine white sand beaches, try complimentary water sports, and indulge in the resort ambiance. This is a perfect honeymoon splurge day.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your guesthouse by late afternoon. Treat yourself to a sundowner mocktail or fresh juice at the guesthouse bar. Reflect on the midpoint of your trip and plan remaining days.

meals.breakfast: Early guesthouse breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Included in resort day pass or purchase at the resort restaurant — budget $20–$40 for a resort lunch
meals.dinner: Back at the guesthouse — simple local dinner to balance the day's splurge, $8–$12

day_by_day.notes: Research resort day passes in advance — Coco Bodu Hithi, Anantara Veli, and Taj Coral Reef are popular options in North Malé Atoll. Book at least 2–3 days ahead as day passes sell out quickly. This is the best way to experience Maldivian luxury on a budget.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing trip with local fishermen — traditional Maldivian pole-and-line fishing (handline fishing). Many guesthouses arrange sunrise fishing excursions for $20–$35 per person. It's a culturally immersive and fun experience, especially romantic at sunrise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cook your catch — if your guesthouse has kitchen facilities, ask the chef to prepare your freshly caught fish Maldivian-style. If not, the guesthouse kitchen can usually cook it for a small fee ($5–$10). Spend the afternoon relaxing at the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic couple's sunset cruise on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat. Many guesthouses offer 1.5–2 hour sunset dhoni cruises for $25–$40 per person. Sip fresh juice, watch the sky turn gold and pink, and enjoy the gentle rocking of the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the fishing trip — toast and tea
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish cooked by the guesthouse chef — a truly unique farm-to-table experience
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — lobster thermidor or grilled barracuda (splurge option, $18–$25) to celebrate the penultimate days of the trip

day_by_day.notes: The fishing excursion is typically catch-and-cook style — the freshest possible seafood. Tip the local fishermen who take you out ($5–$10 is appreciated). The sunset dhoni cruise is one of the most romantic activities available at budget prices.

day_by_day.morning: Final full snorkeling day — revisit your favorite reef spots and spend quality time underwater. Take mental snapshots of the coral gardens, fish, and marine life. Try to spot any species you haven't seen yet — octopus, moray eels, or lionfish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping and packing. Visit the local island market for affordable Maldivian souvenirs — lacquerware boxes ($5–$15), woven mats, dried fish keychains, and local spices. Pack carefully to avoid airline overweight fees.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner — celebrate your 13-day Maldives adventure with a special meal. Ask the guesthouse to prepare a traditional Maldivian feast — a spread of local dishes including mas riha, garudhiya, fihunu mas (grilled fish), coconut sambal, and fresh tropical fruit for dessert.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — enjoy a full spread one last time
meals.lunch: Light lunch — local short eats and fresh coconut water while shopping
meals.dinner: Special farewell Maldivian feast at the guesthouse — $15–$25 per person for a curated local spread

day_by_day.notes: Check airline luggage restrictions before buying souvenirs — coral, shells, and certain marine products are illegal to export from the Maldives. Stick to fabric crafts, lacquerware, and locally made food products. Settle any outstanding guesthouse bills tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Take a final swim or snorkel in the crystal-clear lagoon. Enjoy a slow farewell breakfast and exchange contacts with guesthouse staff and fellow travelers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the guesthouse and arrange transfer back to Velana International Airport. Allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight for ferry/speedboat transfer and airport check-in. Take one last look at the turquoise waters as you depart.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 incredible days of snorkeling, romance, island life, and unforgettable Maldivian sunsets.

meals.breakfast: Final guesthouse breakfast — fresh tropical fruit, eggs, and Maldivian black tea
meals.lunch: Airport café or lounge — local snacks or a light meal before the flight, $8–$15
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at connecting airport

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your return transfer the night before. Public ferries to Malé run on fixed schedules — check the timetable carefully. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5 hours before international departure. Keep all receipts for any travel insurance claims. The Maldives has a $30 airport departure tax typically included in your ticket price.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled – flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet your resort transfer representative. Board a speedboat or dhoni transfer to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll (approx. 20–45 min). Check in, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds to get oriented. Enjoy a welcome drink and explore your overwater or beach bungalow.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the resort's beach or jetty. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed welcome dinner featuring fresh seafood and local Maldivian flavors.

meals.breakfast: N/A – in transit
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Velana International Airport before/after landing
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant – try the grilled reef fish or lobster thermidor; budget around $40–60 per person

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light and relaxing. Hydrate well after the flight. Confirm all upcoming excursion bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Ask about house reef snorkeling conditions and tide timings.

day_by_day.morning: After a leisurely breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for an introductory snorkeling session. Explore the shallow lagoon and get comfortable with the underwater visibility. Spot reef fish, sea turtles, and colorful corals just steps from your bungalow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the resort's guided Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Banana Reef – one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites in North Malé Atoll. Swim alongside napoleon wrasse, moray eels, parrotfish, and vibrant hard and soft corals. The safari typically runs 2–3 hours with snorkeling equipment provided.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couples' sunset cocktail hour at the overwater bar. Dine at a casual beachside grill for a romantic dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort – fresh tropical fruits, eggs, pastries, and local roshi flatbread
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café – fish sandwiches, salads, and fresh coconut water ($15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Beachside barbecue dinner at the resort – grilled mahi-mahi, calamari, and local vegetable curry ($45–65 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef is best snorkeled in the morning when visibility is highest. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only. Book this experience through the resort concierge the night before to confirm boat times.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow morning with breakfast in bed or on your private deck. Take a peaceful kayak or paddleboard session in the resort's calm lagoon. Ideal for couples to explore at their own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat. Enjoy a 90-minute private couples' massage and body treatment in an overwater spa pavilion with glass floors revealing the turquoise ocean below. Treatments typically include aromatherapy massage, coconut scrub, and a floral bath.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll the resort's beach at dusk and enjoy a private sunset cocktail on your bungalow deck. Dine at the resort's à la carte restaurant for a more refined experience.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast service or resort buffet – tropical fruits, yogurt, freshly baked bread, and Maldivian hedhikaa (local snacks)
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch – Caesar salad, club sandwich, or fresh fruit platter ($20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: À la carte dinner at the resort's signature restaurant – pan-seared tuna, lobster bisque, and chocolate lava cake for dessert ($50–70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa retreat at least 24–48 hours in advance as couples' slots fill quickly. Arrive 15 minutes early to enjoy the pre-treatment relaxation lounge. Avoid heavy meals immediately before the spa session.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide for the best marine life activity. Look out for reef sharks, stingrays, and schools of surgeonfish. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for memorable shots.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class. Take a short boat ride to a nearby local island (common in North Malé Atoll such as Huraa or Thulusdhoo). Explore the island on foot, visit the local mosque, traditional homes, and the island's fishing harbor. Learn about Maldivian history and craftsmanship.
day_by_day.evening: Continue the cooking class in the late afternoon – learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth), and bondi (coconut flatbread). Enjoy your creations as dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast
meals.lunch: Included as part of the cultural tour – local Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Dishes prepared during the cooking class served family-style on the local island or back at the resort ($30–50 per person if not fully included in tour price)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting local islands – cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs. The cooking class is a wonderful romantic activity and a great way to connect with Maldivian culture. Confirm tour pickup time with the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Relax with a late breakfast and enjoy your resort's amenities – swim in the infinity pool, read on a hammock over the water, or simply soak in the beauty of your surroundings. A true 'do-nothing' morning for rest and romance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head back to Banana Reef or an alternative nearby reef for a second snorkeling excursion, this time focusing on underwater photography. Many resorts offer guided snorkeling with a marine biologist who can identify species and point out hidden creatures like octopus and seahorses.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne. Board a traditional wooden dhoni boat and sail through crystal-clear waters as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, canapés, and a breathtaking 360° sunset view – the ultimate romantic Maldives experience.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort buffet or in-room dining
meals.lunch: Light resort café lunch – fresh sushi rolls, prawn salad, or a mezze platter ($20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Return from the dhoni cruise and enjoy dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant – fresh catch of the day with a curated wine pairing ($55–75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise is one of the most romantic experiences in the Maldives – book it well in advance. Bring a light wrap or shawl as it can get breezy on the water in the evening. Sunset time in March is approximately 18:15–18:30 local time.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga or meditation session on the beach or your bungalow deck – many boutique resorts in North Malé Atoll offer complimentary or low-cost guided sessions. A peaceful and centering start to the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's water sports offerings – try windsurfing, stand-up paddleboarding, or a glass-bottom kayak tour over the reef. These activities are ideal for couples and provide a different perspective of the underwater world without getting wet.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beach picnic dinner arranged by the resort. Many boutique properties offer private beach setups with lanterns, a dedicated server, and a customized menu – perfect for a honeymoon evening under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast – smoothie bowl, granola, and fresh tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Resort beach bar lunch – fish tacos, grilled corn, and fresh lime juice ($20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Private beach picnic dinner arranged by the resort – typically includes a 3-course set menu with seafood, salads, and dessert ($70–100 per couple, often a special add-on package)

day_by_day.notes: Inquire about the resort's romance packages – many boutique stays in the Maldives offer honeymoon add-ons such as private beach dinners, flower arrangements, and complimentary cake at a discounted bundle rate. Book at least 48 hours ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip – enjoy a slow, indulgent morning. Order a full in-room breakfast and spend the morning on your private terrace or deck. Reflect on the week's experiences and plan the second half of the trip with your partner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience for a special midday or early afternoon dining experience. Descend below the ocean's surface and dine surrounded by panoramic views of the reef, with fish, rays, and corals gliding past the glass walls. A world-class and unforgettable luxury experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a quiet evening. Take a night snorkeling session if offered by the resort (bioluminescent plankton can be visible in March). Relax with a nightcap at the overwater bar.

meals.breakfast: Full in-room breakfast service – eggs benedict, fresh juice, pastries, and local Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: The Underwater Restaurant Experience (this IS the lunch/early dining event) – a set tasting menu with 4–5 courses featuring international and Maldivian fusion cuisine ($80–150 per person; book well in advance)
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's casual beach café – pasta, pizza, or fresh salads ($25–40 per person) to balance the indulgent lunch

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is one of the most sought-after dining experiences in the Maldives. Reservations must be made weeks in advance. Dress code is typically smart casual. Confirm the specific restaurant name and transfer logistics with your resort concierge as it may require a short boat ride.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided dolphin watching excursion in the morning – North Malé Atoll is known for spinner dolphin pods that are frequently spotted in the early morning hours. Board a small boat and cruise the open waters for a magical wildlife encounter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend a relaxing afternoon at the pool or beach. Enjoy a couples' mocktail or cocktail from the swim-up bar. Optional: visit the resort's boutique for local handicrafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy another Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or opt for a stargazing experience on the beach or a resort-arranged astronomy session if available. The Maldives' remote location offers spectacular dark skies.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort – burgers, wraps, and fresh juices ($20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant – try the Maldivian curry night if available, featuring fish curry, vegetable curry, and steamed rice ($40–55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching is best in the early morning. Ask the resort about the best spots and whether they include a naturalist guide. Spinner dolphins are common in North Malé Atoll but sightings are never guaranteed – keep expectations flexible and enjoy the boat ride regardless.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari – second excursion, this time to a different reef site. Ask the resort to recommend an alternative snorkeling spot such as HP Reef (Maaya Thila) or a nearby sandbank. Explore new marine life and enjoy the variety of underwater landscapes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sandbank picnic experience – many resorts in North Malé Atoll arrange transfers to a secluded sandbank (a tiny strip of white sand in the middle of the ocean). Spend the afternoon swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying a packed picnic lunch in complete privacy.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed. Enjoy a couples' bath ritual in your bungalow (many boutique resorts offer a flower bath turndown service). Dine at the resort's restaurant with a focus on local Maldivian cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Light resort breakfast – yogurt parfait, fresh fruit, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch arranged by the resort – sandwiches, tropical fruit, cold drinks, and local snacks (often included in the sandbank excursion package or $20–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Maldivian-themed dinner at the resort – garudhiya soup, mas riha (fish curry), and roshi flatbread ($40–55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank experience is weather-dependent and tide-dependent. Confirm the timing with the resort. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, hats, and sunglasses as there is no shade on a sandbank. This is a quintessential Maldives experience not to be missed.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a second Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat or choose individual treatments from the spa menu – options may include a hot stone massage, facial, or reflexology session. A wonderful way to pamper yourselves mid-trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's snorkeling trail independently using a provided map of the house reef. Look for specific marine life highlighted by the resort's marine biologist. Alternatively, rent a kayak and paddle to a nearby shallow reef.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's bar for a mixology session or cocktail tasting event if offered. Enjoy dinner at the overwater restaurant with a curated seafood platter for two.

meals.breakfast: Full resort buffet breakfast
meals.lunch: Light spa-day lunch – fresh salads, cold-pressed juices, and hummus platters ($15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant seafood platter for two – lobster, prawns, calamari, and grilled fish with sides and dessert ($80–110 for two)

day_by_day.notes: Many boutique resorts offer spa packages that include multiple treatments at a discounted rate. Ask about honeymooner or couple's packages when booking. Avoid sun exposure immediately after certain treatments.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing excursion – join a traditional Maldivian line fishing trip at dawn. This is a culturally authentic experience where you fish using handlines in the traditional Maldivian style. Your catch may be prepared by the resort chef for a meal.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon relaxing and enjoying the resort's facilities. Use the afternoon for leisure – reading, swimming, or simply gazing at the turquoise lagoon. Optional: take a resort-guided island nature walk.
day_by_day.evening: Have your morning's catch prepared by the resort chef in a cooking demonstration or simply served as a custom dinner – a unique and personal dining experience. Pair with a bottle of wine from the resort's cellar.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast – coffee, pastries, and fresh fruit
meals.lunch: Resort café lunch after returning from fishing – pasta, salads, or a light curry ($20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Custom dinner featuring your morning catch prepared by the resort chef – typically grilled or pan-seared with local spices and sides ($45–65 per person including chef service)

day_by_day.notes: The fishing excursion usually departs at 05:30–06:00. Confirm timing the night before. Bring a light jacket as it can be cool on the water before sunrise. This is a memorable and authentic experience that connects you with the Maldivian fishing heritage.

day_by_day.morning: Final full snorkeling day – revisit your favorite reef or explore a new spot recommended by the resort. Take time to appreciate the underwater world one last time and capture final photos and videos. Consider a guided snorkeling session with the resort's marine biologist.
day_by_day.afternoon: Shopping and souvenir afternoon – arrange a day trip to Malé (the capital) via a short speedboat ride. Explore the local markets, the Grand Friday Mosque, and the National Museum. Pick up local handicrafts, lacquerware, and Maldivian souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a final romantic dinner. Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise again if desired, or arrange a special farewell dinner with the resort – many boutique properties offer a complimentary honeymoon cake or special setup for departing couples.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast – enjoy all your favorites one last time
meals.lunch: Lunch in Malé at a local restaurant – try short eats at a local café, fresh tuna sandwiches, and Maldivian tea ($10–15 per person for an authentic local experience)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant – a special 4-course dinner with wine pairing to celebrate the honeymoon ($80–120 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Malé is a short 20–30 minute speedboat ride from most North Malé Atoll resorts. The fish market and local bazaar are highlights. Carry cash (Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD) for local market purchases. Pack your bags in the evening for an organized departure the next day.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise – wake up early for one last sunrise view from your bungalow or the beach. Take a final dip in the lagoon or a morning swim. Enjoy a leisurely farewell breakfast at the resort. Complete checkout formalities and settle any remaining bills.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final relaxed morning at the resort. The resort may offer a late checkout option (confirm in advance) so you can enjoy the facilities until your transfer time. Board the speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport with memories of an unforgettable 13-day Maldives honeymoon. Reflect on the sunsets, the turquoise lagoons, the underwater wonders, and the romance of this paradise destination.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast – a special farewell spread; request your favorite dishes from the chef
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport or resort before departure – sandwiches, wraps, and fresh juice ($15–20 per person)
meals.dinner: Inflight meal or dinner at your transit airport

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout (typically until 14:00 or 16:00) when booking or at check-in, especially for honeymoon guests – many resorts accommodate this as a complimentary gesture. Arrive at the airport at least 2–3 hours before international departure. Consider purchasing a Maldivian lacquerware piece or handwoven mat as a final keepsake.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sailing through crystal-clear turquoise lagoons as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky transform into shades of gold and pink. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable experience.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most iconic and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with exotic marine life including reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and hundreds of tropical fish species. A guided snorkeling safari ensures you discover the best spots while learning about the delicate coral ecosystem. Equipment is provided and the waters are warm and exceptionally clear.
experiences.location: Banana Reef, North Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Indulge in a world-class luxury dining experience at an iconic underwater restaurant, surrounded by panoramic views of the Indian Ocean and its stunning marine life. Savor a curated multi-course menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, international gourmet dishes, and fine wines while fish and rays glide gracefully past the glass walls — a truly magical and romantic dinner for two.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Discover the rich heritage and traditions of the Maldivian people with a guided tour of a local island village. Visit a traditional mosque, watch local craftsmen weave lacquerware, and learn about the island's fishing culture. Cap the experience with a hands-on cooking class where you prepare authentic Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) and garudhiya fish soup.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat
experiences.description: Treat yourselves to the ultimate luxury honeymoon indulgence with a private couples' spa session in an overwater treatment pavilion. Enjoy traditional Maldivian Javanese massages, aromatic flower baths, and rejuvenating body scrubs using locally sourced coconut and sea salt. The open-air deck offers breathtaking views of the lagoon below, making this a deeply relaxing and romantic escape.
experiences.location: Velaa Private Island, Noonu Atoll, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then meet your private resort transfer coordinator. Board a luxury speedboat or seaplane transfer to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll. Check in, receive a traditional Maldivian welcome with fresh coconut water and flower garlands. Settle into your overwater villa or beach bungalow, unpack, and explore your private accommodation and its amenities.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a leisurely Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sailing through crystal-clear turquoise waters as the sun dips below the horizon. Toast to your arrival with chilled champagne and canapés.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast on board your flight
meals.lunch: Light welcome refreshments and tropical fruit platter at the resort upon check-in
meals.dinner: Intimate in-villa dining experience — a curated 4-course Maldivian-fusion menu served on your private deck over the water, with candles and starlit skies

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep the schedule relaxed and indulgent. Confirm all upcoming activity bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Request any special honeymoon arrangements (rose petal turndown, champagne, etc.) to be prepared in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely overwater breakfast served on your private deck as the morning sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Afterward, head to the resort's house reef for a guided snorkeling orientation session with the marine biologist on staff — discover the colorful coral gardens, reef fish, and sea turtles that inhabit the lagoon directly accessible from your villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat — a private, immersive spa session in a glass-floored overwater pavilion. Enjoy synchronised deep-tissue massages, aromatic body scrubs using local coconut and frangipani, and a Jacuzzi soak with panoramic ocean views. This is the ultimate honeymoon indulgence.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner cocktails at the resort's overwater bar, watching the sky transform into hues of gold and pink. Dress for a romantic dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Overwater deck breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, freshly baked pastries, and Maldivian roshi flatbread with coconut sambol
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled lobster rolls, ceviche, and fresh tropical juices
meals.dinner: Signature fine-dining restaurant at the resort — a 5-course tasting menu featuring fresh Maldivian tuna, reef lobster, and imported premium ingredients, paired with a curated wine list

day_by_day.notes: Book the Couples Spa Retreat at least 24 hours in advance if not pre-booked. Request the 'honeymoon package' add-on for extra rose petals, champagne, and personalized touches during the spa session.

day_by_day.morning: After breakfast, embark on the Coral Reef Snorkeling Safari at Banana Reef — one of the Maldives' most iconic and vibrant coral reefs. Board a private dhoni with a professional marine guide and snorkel among Napoleon wrasse, moray eels, sea turtles, and kaleidoscopic reef fish. Banana Reef is easily accessible from North Malé Atoll, making it a perfect day excursion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend a leisurely afternoon by your private pool or on the beach. Enjoy a couples' kayaking session through the calm lagoon, exploring the mangrove edges and sandbanks nearby. Alternatively, rent stand-up paddleboards and glide across the glassy turquoise water.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private sandbank dinner — your resort butler will set up a table for two on a secluded sandbank in the middle of the ocean, illuminated by lanterns and torches. A private chef will serve a seafood BBQ feast under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — extensive spread of international and Maldivian options including mas huni (tuna and coconut), fresh juices, and artisan coffees
meals.lunch: Picnic-style lunch on the dhoni during the snorkeling safari — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit, and chilled beverages prepared by the resort
meals.dinner: Private sandbank BBQ dinner — freshly caught lobster, prawns, reef fish, and grilled vegetables, with a bottle of Champagne and a personalized dessert

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef snorkeling safari typically departs in the morning for the best visibility and calm seas. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, underwater cameras, and rash guards. Sandbank dinner must be pre-booked at least 48 hours in advance and is weather-dependent.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga session on the beach or your overwater deck, led by the resort's private yoga instructor. Follow with a nourishing breakfast. Then join a guided dolphin-watching excursion by private speedboat — the waters around North Malé Atoll are renowned for large pods of spinner dolphins that are active in the morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience for a spectacular lunch — dine surrounded by panoramic views of the coral reef and its marine inhabitants through floor-to-ceiling glass panels. This iconic Maldivian experience is a bucket-list highlight for honeymooners.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxing evening. Enjoy a private sunset cocktail hour on your villa deck, followed by a romantic movie night arranged by the resort — an outdoor cinema set up on the beach with blankets, popcorn, and your favorite films under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Healthy wellness breakfast — acai bowls, granola, fresh-pressed green juices, avocado toast, and herbal teas served post-yoga
meals.lunch: Underwater restaurant — a luxury multi-course menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, premium sashimi, and international gourmet dishes, paired with fine wines
meals.dinner: In-villa private chef dinner — a personalized 4-course menu prepared in your villa kitchen and served on your deck, featuring a menu designed around your preferences

day_by_day.notes: The underwater restaurant is a premium experience and requires a reservation well in advance — confirm with the concierge on Day 1. Dolphin sightings are highly likely in the morning but are subject to natural wildlife patterns.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning with a floating breakfast in your private villa pool — a quintessential Maldivian luxury experience with a tray of tropical fruits, pastries, and coffee floating on the water. Afterward, take a guided snorkeling session on the resort's house reef to spot manta rays that frequently visit the area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — take a short boat ride to a nearby local island to discover the rich heritage and traditions of the Maldivian people. Tour the village, visit a traditional boat-building workshop, and then learn to cook authentic Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth), mas riha (fish curry), and bis keemiya (pastries).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed and culturally enriched. Enjoy a sundowner at the overwater bar, then head to a romantic beachfront dinner.

meals.breakfast: Floating pool breakfast — tropical fruit platter, croissants, eggs your way, fresh juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch prepared during the cooking class on the local island — an authentic and memorable cultural meal
meals.dinner: Beachfront fine-dining at the resort — fresh catch of the day grilled with local spices, accompanied by premium sides and a curated wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: The cultural village tour is a wonderful way to connect with the local community and understand the Maldivian way of life beyond the resort bubble. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (shoulders and knees covered). Bring small cash for local crafts and souvenirs.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a deep-dive snorkeling adventure at a nearby dive site in North Malé Atoll — explore a spectacular underwater pinnacle or drift snorkel along a channel known for shark sightings (white-tip and black-tip reef sharks), eagle rays, and large pelagic fish. A professional guide accompanies you throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Treat yourselves to an indulgent couple's facial and body wrap at the resort spa, using locally sourced ingredients like coconut oil, sea salt, and tropical botanicals. Relax in the spa's relaxation lounge with herbal teas and fresh juices afterward.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — a repeat of the magic from Day 1, this time with a different route exploring quieter lagoons and uninhabited islands. Watch bioluminescent plankton light up the water after dark as you sail back.

meals.breakfast: Continental breakfast at the resort — freshly baked breads, cold cuts, cheeses, yogurts, and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch — seared tuna salad, fresh spring rolls, coconut shrimp, and chilled mocktails
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant at the resort — a premium seafood and steak menu with ocean views, accompanied by a sommelier-selected wine list

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton is most visible on moonless nights — check the lunar calendar and plan the evening dhoni cruise accordingly. The spa treatments should be booked 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — dedicate today to pure relaxation and romance. Sleep in and enjoy a champagne breakfast in bed arranged by your butler. Take a slow morning walk along the beach, collecting shells and watching the tide pools come to life. Visit the resort's marine biology center to learn about coral restoration efforts and adopt a coral fragment as a meaningful honeymoon memento.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy an exclusive private island picnic arranged by the resort — a short boat ride to a secluded uninhabited island where your butler sets up a luxury picnic with gourmet food, chilled beverages, hammocks, and snorkeling gear. Have the entire island to yourselves for the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a couple's cooking class with the resort's head chef — learn to prepare a traditional Maldivian dinner together, then enjoy the fruits of your labor in a private dining setting.

meals.breakfast: Champagne in-bed breakfast — smoked salmon bagels, fresh fruits, pastries, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon
meals.lunch: Private island picnic — gourmet sandwiches, charcuterie board, tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, and chilled rosé wine
meals.dinner: Couples cooking class dinner — dishes prepared by yourselves with the chef's guidance, enjoyed in a private romantic setting

day_by_day.notes: The private island picnic is one of the most romantic experiences available in the Maldives — pre-book at least 3 days in advance. The coral adoption certificate makes a wonderful keepsake of your honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise fishing trip — join a traditional Maldivian-style handline fishing excursion at dawn. Experience the thrill of catching reef fish and tuna in the traditional way, accompanied by local fishermen. The experience is both authentic and exhilarating against the backdrop of a spectacular Indian Ocean sunrise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with a curated selection of cocktails and mocktails from the pool bar. Enjoy a private mixology class with the resort's bartender — learn to craft classic Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like coconut, pandan, and tropical fruits.
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for an elegant dinner at the resort's most exclusive restaurant — a black-tie optional dining experience with a degustation menu, live acoustic music, and impeccable service.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — fresh fruit, energy bars, and coffee/tea before departure; full Maldivian breakfast upon return
meals.lunch: Freshly caught fish from the morning's excursion, grilled by the resort chef and served beachside with local accompaniments
meals.dinner: Degustation menu at the resort's signature restaurant — 7-course tasting menu with wine pairings, featuring premium imported and locally sourced ingredients

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise fishing trip departs very early (around 05:30–06:00) — arrange an early wake-up call with the resort. The catch-and-cook experience of having your morning fish prepared for lunch is a uniquely satisfying Maldivian tradition.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a snorkeling safari to a different reef system in North Malé Atoll — explore a coral garden renowned for its density of marine life, including schools of barracuda, giant Napoleon wrasse, and colorful nudibranchs. A professional underwater photographer accompanies you to capture stunning images of your snorkeling adventure as a honeymoon keepsake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon exploring the resort's water sports facilities — try jet skiing, windsurfing, or parasailing for an adrenaline-fueled contrast to the serene snorkeling mornings. Alternatively, take a glass-bottom kayak tour of the lagoon for a more relaxed option.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a private beachfire experience — your butler arranges a bonfire on a secluded stretch of beach with comfortable seating, blankets, and a personalized cocktail service. Watch the Milky Way emerge as darkness falls over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Poolside breakfast — full English breakfast option or Maldivian mas huni with roshi, fresh juices, and specialty coffees
meals.lunch: Beach grill lunch — grilled reef fish tacos, fresh ceviche, tropical fruit smoothies, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Private beachfire dinner — a curated BBQ menu served by your personal butler at the bonfire, with a selection of premium wines and a decadent dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Book the underwater photographer in advance — the resulting images will be among your most treasured honeymoon memories. The beachfire experience is weather-dependent; have an indoor backup plan ready.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a couple's meditation and breathwork session on the beach at sunrise, led by the resort's wellness specialist. Follow with a nourishing spa breakfast. Then embark on a guided mangrove kayaking tour through the natural mangrove ecosystems of a nearby island — a serene and ecologically fascinating experience unique to the region.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a full afternoon of pure luxury indulgence. Book a second round of the Couples Overwater Bungalow Spa Retreat — this time opting for a different treatment menu, such as a hot stone massage, aromatherapy wrap, and private Jacuzzi session with ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the penultimate phase of your honeymoon with a special anniversary or honeymoon dinner arranged by the resort — a fully personalized dining experience with custom decorations, a personalized menu, a wedding cake or dessert, and a private serenade by a local musician.

meals.breakfast: Wellness spa breakfast — smoothie bowls, overnight oats, fresh fruits, herbal teas, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch — grilled fish with quinoa, fresh salads, and detox juices served at the spa relaxation lounge
meals.dinner: Personalized honeymoon dinner — a fully bespoke 5-course menu designed around your preferences, served in a private decorated beachside setting with a personal serenade

day_by_day.notes: Discuss the special honeymoon dinner arrangements with the concierge at least 3 days in advance to allow for custom decorations, a personalized menu, and musician booking. This will be one of the most memorable evenings of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning speedboat excursion to a nearby dive site famous for manta ray cleaning stations — even as snorkelers, you can witness the spectacular sight of manta rays circling gracefully in the water. This is one of the most awe-inspiring wildlife encounters available in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a final afternoon of water sports and leisure. Rent a private catamaran for a couple's sailing experience around the atoll — sail at your own pace, anchor at a sandbank, and swim in the open ocean. The resort's sailing instructor can accompany you if needed.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final overwater bar sunset experience with premium cocktails, followed by dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant with a live local band performing traditional Maldivian music.

meals.breakfast: Overwater deck breakfast — eggs your way, smoked salmon, fresh tropical fruits, freshly squeezed juices, and artisan coffee
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet picnic on the catamaran — lobster rolls, artisan cheeses, charcuterie, fresh fruits, and chilled rosé
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant with live music — a la carte menu featuring freshly caught seafood, premium steaks, and decadent desserts

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray encounters are seasonal and location-dependent — confirm with the resort's dive center about current manta activity in the area. The private catamaran rental is a wonderful way to feel the freedom of the open ocean.

day_by_day.morning: On your penultimate morning, revisit your favorite snorkeling spot on the house reef for one last underwater exploration — take time to say goodbye to the sea turtles and reef fish that have become familiar faces over the past two weeks. Bring an underwater camera for final photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon indulging in a final spa treatment — a relaxing Swedish massage and scalp treatment to prepare your body for the journey home. Afterward, browse the resort's boutique for premium Maldivian souvenirs, locally crafted jewelry, and artisan products to take home.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a private stargazing session arranged by the resort — lie on sun loungers on the beach with a telescope, guided by the resort's astronomy enthusiast, while enjoying warm beverages and light snacks. Identify constellations visible from the Southern Hemisphere for a magical final evening.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast at the main restaurant — a final indulgent spread of your favorite dishes from the past two weeks
meals.lunch: Leisurely poolside lunch — a curated selection of your favorite dishes from the trip, as a nostalgic farewell meal
meals.dinner: Elegant farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — a special goodbye menu curated by the head chef, with a complimentary bottle of Champagne from the resort

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort photographer to capture final couple portraits on the beach during golden hour as a lasting memory of your honeymoon. Begin packing and organizing belongings in the evening. Confirm departure transfer logistics with the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy one final sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your villa deck — take a moment to soak in the beauty and tranquility of the Maldives one last time. Have a leisurely farewell breakfast before checking out. The resort butler will assist with luggage and transfer arrangements.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, the resort can arrange a late checkout or a day-use villa to freshen up before your transfer. Board your private speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport in Male, taking in the stunning aerial or sea-level views of the atolls one final time.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days of romance, luxury, and unforgettable memories in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

meals.breakfast: Farewell breakfast — a special spread of all your favorite items from the trip, with a personalized farewell card from the resort team
meals.lunch: Light airport lunch or in-lounge dining at Velana International Airport's premium lounge if available
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or at your connecting airport, depending on your flight schedule

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout (typically until 14:00 or later for premium guests) to maximize your final hours at the resort. The resort team will likely prepare a small farewell gift or keepsake — a wonderful tradition of Maldivian hospitality. Ensure all travel documents, souvenirs, and purchased items are organized for the journey home.
